milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate toward the nether brick slab structure (roof slabs centered at spawn-relative 0,4,9) and face it. max_distance=10 ensures the player is reasonably close (within ~10 blocks of the roof center), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure rather than facing away. The structure is ~6 blocks from spawn so the player may need to move slightly forward and look up toward the slab roof.

Uses inventory_has because mining mossy_cobblestone_stairs with a pickaxe causes the block to drop itself as an item, which the player picks up into inventory. The player is given an iron pickaxe at scene start (no mossy_cobblestone_stairs in starting inventory), so having at least 1 in inventory proves the player successfully mined and collected the block. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has is the most reliable and direct check.
